name: Nodemailer
solves: Sends emails from Node.js applications over SMTP, sendmail, AWS SES, or custom transports, handling MIME message construction, DKIM signing, attachments, HTML content, OAuth2 authentication, and connection pooling.
best_for: Sending transactional emails via your own SMTP server or existing email provider from any Node.js backend
Apps that need DKIM signing, attachments, HTML emails, and full control over SMTP configuration without a third-party email API
Projects using AWS SES that want a familiar Node.js API wrapper with connection pooling and message composition
Self-hosted or on-premise deployments where you cannot use external email SaaS providers
Prototyping and development with Ethereal test accounts for email previewing without real delivery
skip_when: You need a managed email delivery service with built-in analytics, bounce handling, and deliverability optimization out of the box
Your project requires email template management, A/B testing, or marketing automation features
You want a REST API-based email service without managing SMTP connections or transport configuration
You are building a serverless application where persistent SMTP connections are impractical and a stateless HTTP-based email API is preferable
You need guaranteed deliverability with dedicated IP warming and reputation management handled for you

hosted_alternative.name: SendGrid
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier: 100 emails/day; Essentials from $19.95/mo for 50k emails
